system.description:
You move faster than mortal eyes can follow, blurring across the ground while bystanders seem to stand as statues.

By expending a Blood Trait, in addition to the benefits of Rapidity, you gain a third action, which takes place after all actions of vampires using Swiftness. This action may be used only for physical feats. Celerity draws no retest from any Ability, though each action may be retested by its own Ability, and a surprised character cannot use Celerity on the first challenge; where two speed-users vie for the same benefit, the one with the higher Celerity acts first. The effect lasts one turn.
